name: Deep links
summary: Links that open Claude Code in the right folder with a prompt ready to send.
what: A claude-cli:// link opens a new terminal running Claude Code in a chosen repository or folder, with a prompt already typed. Nothing runs until you press Enter, and prompts from outside are flagged.

impact.title: One click from docs
impact.detail: Put links in runbooks, READMEs and alerts.

impact.title: Right place, right prompt
impact.detail: Opens in the correct repository automatically.

impact.title: Safe by default
impact.detail: You review the prompt before it runs.

howItWorks: Build a link like claude-cli://open?q=<prompt>&repo=owner/name, or use cwd for a path.
Encode line breaks as %0A; prompts are capped at 5,000 characters.
repo only finds clones where you've already run claude.
Turn link handling off with disableDeepLinkRegistration.

events.note: First changelog mention of claude-cli:// deep links.
